RECRUITER SPEAK
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Getting 1250+ offers in a year is really a big achievement for an Engineering college. Your Chairman is a mentor
                            for all the students as he himself is an academician. All the achievers are advised to attain personal excellence
                            with confidence, awareness & execution.
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Teamwork & Hard work brought SV Colleges to this level to attain these many placements. Congrats to all the
                            faculty members & staff who joined their hands in this achievement. Students, while you are joining in any
                            company, start building the foundation by understanding the company’s functioning modules which helps you
                            to be a successful employee.
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
The knowledge which students secure in the college is very important in which ever company you are placed.
                            All the final year students are requested to guide your juniors. Next year we will be competing with other
                            MNCs in hiring large number of students from SV Colleges.
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Congratulations to all the young & aspirant future leaders. The pleasantness & the hospitality in SV Colleges is
                            unique from all the other colleges. Here at SV Colleges, I have seen a sparkle of students with sound technical
                            knowledge which lead me to a surprise.
OUR RECRUITERS
View More
STUDENTS PORTAL
Achievements of SVC Group
Ranked 12th(AAA grade) among Top Engineering Colleges in AP by Careers 360 rankings
Ranked 92th among India’s Best Private T-Schools 2020 rankings by Dataquest
Initiated Spoken Tutorial project funded by the National Mission on Education through Information and
                                        Communication Technology (ICT), launched by the Ministry of Human Resources and Development,
                                        Government of India.
Ranked 54th among India’s Best Private Engineering Colleges 2020 rankings by India Today
Received prestigious “Chhatra Viswakarma Award” from honorable Vice President of India
14 Students selected for University Innovation Fellows by Stanford University and visited Stanford for 3
                                        months program
Nodal Centre for Smart India Hackathon
Group Student Counseling & Guidance
Student counseling has been specifically formed. About 10-15 students are assigned to each teacher to
                                        be guided, motivated and counseled in academic and other matters.
Special workshops and sessions are held on a regular basis and the resume preparation and tips to face
                                        interviews are successfully furnished. This would help parents and students arrive at intelligent and
                                        optimal decisions about their future.
Entrepreneurship Development Program
Entrepreneurship Development is achieved by organizing seminars on opportunities, scope and
                                    various schemes available, by the authorities of
Department of Small Scale Industries
State Financial Corporation
Leading Financial Institutions
District Industries
Successful Entrepreneurs are invited to share their experiences and to offer suggestions and
                                    guidance to the students
Industry Relations & Initiatives
Innovation & Entrepreneurship Development Centre (IEDC) sponsored by department of Science &
                                        Technology (DST), Govt. of India.
Established startup Incubator in collaboration with Dept. of Information Technology, Govt. of AP.
MoU with ORACLE Academy to offer Advanced Computer Science course on campus.
Research & Mobile Applications Development (RMD) Lab initiative in association with Computer
                                        Society of India (CSI)
Established robotics lab ‘e -yantra’ in association with IIT Bombay
MoU with National Instruments for CLAD certification to students
Received funding worth of Rs.2 Crores from DST, SERB, and other funding agencies
Established Institute Innovation Council sponsored by Ministry of Human Resource Development, New
                                        Delhi.
Established Center of Excellence of LabVIEW academy from National Instruments to provide training on
                                        LabVIEW
MoU with NPHSAT Pvt. Ltd. for training students to design small satellites
Fruitful Dialogue with Industries
The industries offer the following activities which facilitate the creation of knowledge-driven, highly
                                    skilled young professionals by inculcating great values, work-ethics and leadership skills in them.
Industry Participation in Curriculum Planning
Continuing Education and Internship for Faculty
Industrial Training for Students
Projects Consultancy
Collaborative Programs with Industry
Guest lecturers from Industry
Placements
Student Counselling and Guidance
Student Career Development
Entrepreneurship Development Program
Coaching Programs
To ensure the excellence of students’ performance at competitive examinations for pursuing higher studies,
                                    the following programs are undertaken:
Coaching for GRE, TOEFL and GMAT for students going abroad
Coaching for professional post-graduate entrance examinations like GATE
Guidance for pursuing Civil Services Exams
Guidance for National and State-level MBA entrance examination
